summary:
bash: echo "=== 1. base ==="
stat -c 'mode=%a octal_perms=%A owner=%U group=%G' /srv/shared
echo "=== 2. current ACL ==="
getfacl -p /srv/shared 2>/dev/null | grep -v '^#'
echo "=== 3. assertions ==="
a=$(getfacl -p /srv/shared 2>/dev/null)
for pat in 'group:research:rwx' 'user:alice:rwx' 'user:bob:rwx' 'mask::rwx' 'other::---' \
           'default:group:research:rwx' 'default:user:alice:rwx' 'default:user:bob:rwx' \
           'default:mask::rwx' 'default:other::---'; do
  echo "$a" | grep -qx "$pat" && echo "OK   $pat" || echo "FAIL $pat"
done
echo "=== setgid bit ==="
[ $(( $(stat -c %a /srv/shared) & 2000 )) -eq 2048 ] && echo "OK   setgid set" || echo "FAIL setgid"
echo "=== empty ==="
echo "entries=$(find /srv/shared -mindepth 1 | wc -l)"
